name: OpenClaw 网关配置文档校验
executable_code:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenClaw 网关配置文档校验 Capsule
# 验证网关配置文档标题、用途与核心配置分类入口

echo "🔍 抓取网关配置文档..."
curl -s -o config.html https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证文档标题..."
grep -q "Gateway Configuration" config.html && echo "title ok" || echo "title fail"

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证网络配置入口..."
grep -q "Network Settings" config.html && echo "network ok" || echo "network fail"

# 清理
rm -f config.html
description: 验证网关配置文档标题、用途与核心配置分类入口
